I'll show you how to do this using AMPscript in Salesforce Marketing Cloud.

## Subject Line

In your email subject line, use:

```
%%=ProperCase(FirstName)=%%, your renewal is coming up
```

The `ProperCase()` function capitalizes the first letter of each word and lowercases the rest.

## Email Body

In your email body, add this AMPscript block:

```
%%[
VAR @renewalDate, @daysUntil, @firstName
SET @firstName = FirstName
SET @renewalDate = RenewalDate
SET @daysUntil = DateDiff(@renewalDate, Now(), "D")
]%%

Hi %%=ProperCase(@firstName)=%%,

%%[ IF @daysUntil > 0 THEN ]%%
  Your renewal is coming up in %%=@daysUntil=%% day%%=IIF(@daysUntil == 1, "", "s")=%%.
%%[ ELSEIF @daysUntil == 0 THEN ]%%
  Your renewal is today!
%%[ ELSE ]%%
  Your renewal date has passed. Please contact us to renew your account.
%%[ ENDIF ]%%
```

**Key functions:**
- `DateDiff(date1, date2, "D")` - Returns the number of days between two dates
- `Now()` - Gets the current date/time
- `ProperCase()` - Capitalizes properly
- `IIF()` - Handles singular vs. plural "day/days"

The code checks if `@daysUntil` is positive (future), zero (today), or negative (past) and adjusts the message accordingly.
